title: English Practice Quiz 0781
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Workplace Training 01: The main purpose of induction training is to?
options: help new employees understand their role and workplace procedures
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: help new employees understand their role and workplace procedures.

questions.question: Workplace Training 02: A training needs assessment identifies?
options: the skills and knowledge employees need to develop
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: the skills and knowledge employees need to develop.

questions.question: Workplace Training 03: A learning objective should be?
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: specific and measurable.

questions.question: Workplace Training 04: Practical training is most effective when learners?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: perform tasks under suitable guidance.

questions.question: Workplace Training 05: A refresher course is intended to?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: reinforce knowledge and update skills.

questions.question: Workplace Training 06: Training attendance should be?
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: recorded accurately.

questions.question: Workplace Training 07: A competency assessment checks whether a person can?
options: perform a task to the required standard
questions.explanation: Option C is correct: perform a task to the required standard.

questions.question: Workplace Training 08: Feedback after training should be?
questions.explanation: Option B is correct: specific, constructive and timely.

questions.question: Workplace Training 09: A training evaluation helps determine?
questions.explanation: Option A is correct: whether learning objectives were achieved.

questions.question: Workplace Training 10: A training record should include?
options: the course, date and participant details
questions.explanation: Option D is correct: the course, date and participant details.
